title: Rubin LSST Update — Aug 28, 2026
summary: Routine nightly science operations continue from Cerro Pachón; no new asteroid batches, data releases, or funding developments were found in the Aug 21–28 window despite multiple search strategies. The timeline was backfilled with one previously missing milestone: NAOJ and Subaru Telescope's confirmation of Japan's ongoing LSST contributions (camera operations scientist Yousuke Utsumi stationed on-site, plus data-management and computing support from NAOJ, University of Tokyo, Chiba University, and Nagoya University). Early Data Preview 2's COSMOS mosaic (released early August) remains the most recent major data milestone, with the second EDP2 phase still expected in Q4 2026.

title: Rubin LSST Update — Aug 23, 2026
summary: No new confirmed developments since the last check-in on Aug 20. The observatory continues routine nightly science operations from Cerro Pachón, with the Early Data Preview 2 COSMOS mosaic (released early August) still the most recent major data milestone; the second EDP2 phase with processed and difference images remains expected in Q4 2026. A search across official Rubin/NOIRLab channels, major outlets, and the tracker's RSS sources found no new asteroid batches, data releases, or funding developments in this window.
